quests.instruction: Which trained worker checks that a vehicle is safe and follows all the rules?
quests.hint: Think about the trained worker who carefully checks a car's brakes, lights, and tires to make sure it is safe.
quests.explanation: A vehicle inspector checks that a vehicle is safe. Vehicle inspectors make sure vehicles follow all the safety rules!
quests.funFact: A vehicle inspector checks dozens of important details before approving a car as safe to drive!

quests.instruction: Which patient teacher helps a new driver learn the skills needed to drive safely?
quests.hint: Think about the patient teacher who sits beside a new driver, calmly teaching them how to steer and brake safely.
quests.explanation: A driving instructor teaches new drivers to drive safely. Driving instructors patiently guide every new driver!
quests.funFact: A good driving instructor helps a nervous new driver feel calm, confident, and ready for the road!

quests.instruction: Which expert designs roads, signals, and signs to keep traffic flowing safely?
quests.hint: Think about the expert who plans exactly where traffic lights, lanes, and signs should go on a new road.
quests.explanation: A traffic engineer designs roads and signals. Traffic engineers help keep whole cities moving safely!
quests.funFact: A traffic engineer studies exactly how traffic moves to design safer, smoother roads for everyone!

quests.instruction: Which expert decides where roads, train tracks, and bike paths should go in a growing city?
quests.hint: Think about the expert who plans an entire city's roads and train tracks so everything connects well together.
quests.explanation: An urban planner decides where transportation should go in a city. Urban planners help design well-connected cities!
quests.funFact: A thoughtful urban planner can help a whole city's traffic flow smoothly for many years to come!

quests.instruction: Which expert designs airplanes, rockets, and spacecraft?
quests.hint: Think about the expert who carefully designs every part of a brand new airplane or rocket.
quests.explanation: An aerospace engineer designs airplanes and spacecraft. Aerospace engineers help build safer, faster flying vehicles!
quests.funFact: Aerospace engineers must understand math, science, and physics to design a safe flying vehicle!

quests.instruction: Which expert designs ships and makes sure they can float safely and steadily?
quests.hint: Think about the expert who carefully designs a huge new ship, making sure it will float safely and steadily.
quests.explanation: A naval architect designs ships to float safely. Naval architects plan every detail of a new ship's design!
quests.funFact: A naval architect carefully calculates a ship's shape and weight to make sure it will float perfectly!

quests.instruction: Which large airport offers flights that travel between different countries?
quests.hint: Think about a large, busy airport with flights leaving for faraway countries all around the world.
quests.explanation: An international airport offers flights between countries. International airports connect travelers to the whole world!
quests.funFact: A busy international airport can connect travelers to dozens of different countries all in one place!

quests.instruction: Which type of flight travels between two cities within the very same country?
quests.hint: Think about a flight that travels between two cities, both located within your very own country.
quests.explanation: A domestic flight travels within one country. Domestic flights connect cities inside the very same country!
quests.funFact: A domestic flight is often shorter and quicker than an international flight to another country!

quests.instruction: Which type of flight travels between two different countries?
quests.hint: Think about a flight that takes off in one country and lands in a completely different country far away.
quests.explanation: An international flight travels between two countries. International flights connect travelers around the whole world!
quests.funFact: An international flight often requires a passport to travel between two different countries!

quests.instruction: Which busy central place connects many different bus, train, and subway lines together?
quests.hint: Think about a busy central station where many different bus, train, and subway lines all come together.
quests.explanation: A transit hub connects many transportation lines together. Transit hubs help travelers switch easily between routes!
quests.funFact: A busy transit hub might connect dozens of bus and train lines all in one single, convenient place!

quests.instruction: Which area of a city allows only walking, biking, or public transit, with no cars at all?
quests.hint: Think about a lively city street where only people walking and cyclists are allowed, with no cars in sight.
quests.explanation: A car-free zone allows no cars at all. Car-free zones let people walk and bike safely through a lively area!
quests.funFact: Many cities are creating car-free zones to make their streets quieter, cleaner, and safer for walking!

quests.instruction: Which word describes traveling at a quieter time of day, away from the busiest rush hour?
quests.hint: Think about traveling in the middle of the day, avoiding the busiest, most crowded rush hour times.
quests.explanation: Off-peak travel means traveling during quieter times. Off-peak travel can be cheaper and much less crowded!
quests.funFact: Choosing off-peak travel can help a traveler avoid the most crowded trains and buses of the day!

quests.instruction: Which large map shows every country and ocean on the whole planet?
quests.hint: Think about the large map showing every country, ocean, and continent on the entire planet.
quests.explanation: A world map shows every country and ocean. Travelers study a world map to plan an exciting trip!
quests.funFact: A world map helps show just how far apart different countries really are from one another!

quests.instruction: Which round model of the Earth shows every country in its true, curved shape?
quests.hint: Think about the round, spinning model of the Earth on a stand, showing every country and ocean.
quests.explanation: A globe is a round model of the Earth. A globe shows countries in their true, curved shape and position!
quests.funFact: Spinning a globe and stopping it with your finger is a fun way to imagine a new place to explore!

quests.instruction: Which small mark is placed in a passport each time a traveler enters a new country?
quests.hint: Think about the colorful little stamp added to your passport page each time you visit a brand new country.
quests.explanation: A passport stamp marks each new country a traveler visits. Passport stamps help remember every exciting trip!
quests.funFact: Collecting passport stamps from many countries is like gathering a colorful record of every adventure!

quests.instruction: Which word describes an exciting journey full of new experiences?
quests.hint: Think about an exciting trip full of new sights, new foods, and new experiences you have never had before.
quests.explanation: An adventure is an exciting journey full of new experiences. Every trip can become a memorable adventure!
quests.funFact: The most memorable adventures often come from trying something brand new and a little bit exciting!

quests.instruction: Which word describes someone who has traveled to many different countries around the world?
quests.hint: Think about a person who has visited so many different countries that they seem to know the whole world.
quests.explanation: A globetrotter is a person who travels to many countries. Globetrotters love exploring new places around the world!
quests.funFact: A true globetrotter might visit dozens of different countries over the course of their lifetime!

quests.instruction: Which traveler explores the world with just one bag on their back, often on a budget?
quests.hint: Think about a traveler carrying everything they need in one big bag, exploring the world on a modest budget.
quests.explanation: A backpacker travels with just one bag on their back. Backpackers often explore many places on a budget!
quests.funFact: Backpackers often meet other travelers from all around the world while exploring new countries!

quests.instruction: Which knowledgeable person leads visitors around a place, sharing interesting facts and stories?
quests.hint: Think about the friendly person leading a group around a museum or city, sharing fun facts the whole way.
quests.explanation: A tour guide leads visitors and shares facts. Tour guides help travelers learn about a new place!
quests.funFact: A great tour guide can turn an ordinary visit into an unforgettable, fascinating experience!

quests.instruction: Which colorful pamphlet shows pictures and information about a place to visit?
quests.hint: Think about the colorful pamphlet full of pretty pictures, helping you decide where to go on your next trip.
quests.explanation: A travel brochure shows pictures and information about a destination. Travel brochures help travelers plan their next trip!
quests.funFact: A travel brochure's colorful photos can help spark the idea for an exciting new adventure!

quests.instruction: Which famous structure or place helps travelers recognize and remember a location?
quests.hint: Think about a famous, unforgettable structure, like a tall tower, that helps you recognize a whole city.
quests.explanation: A landmark is a famous structure that helps identify a place. Travelers often visit a landmark on their trip!
quests.funFact: A famous landmark can make a whole city instantly recognizable in photographs from around the world!

quests.instruction: Which popular place draws many visitors who want to see or experience it?
quests.hint: Think about the popular place that draws crowds of visitors, all eager to see it for themselves.
quests.explanation: A tourist attraction is a popular place that draws visitors. Families often plan a trip around a tourist attraction!
quests.funFact: A famous tourist attraction can draw millions of curious visitors every single year!

quests.instruction: Which word describes visiting and looking at interesting or famous places during a trip?
quests.hint: Think about spending a whole day visiting and admiring interesting, famous places during your vacation.
quests.explanation: Sightseeing means visiting and looking at interesting places. Families enjoy sightseeing during a fun vacation!
quests.funFact: A little planning can help make a whole day of sightseeing feel relaxed instead of rushed!

quests.instruction: Which word describes an old stone marker that once showed the distance along a road, or a big achievement?
quests.hint: Think about an old stone marker beside a road showing exactly how many miles remain, or a big personal achievement.
quests.explanation: A milestone is a distance marker along a road, or a big achievement. Milestones once helped travelers track their journey!
quests.funFact: Old stone milestones helped travelers long ago know exactly how far they had already traveled!

quests.instruction: Which post along a road points travelers in the right direction with helpful words?
quests.hint: Think about the wooden post at a crossroads with several arrows pointing toward different towns.
quests.explanation: A signpost points travelers in the right direction. Signposts help guide travelers at a crossroads!
quests.funFact: An old wooden signpost at a crossroads can point the way to several different towns at once!

quests.instruction: Which marked stop along a planned route helps guide a traveler step by step?
quests.hint: Think about a marked stop along a planned route on a map, guiding a traveler one step at a time.
quests.explanation: A waypoint is a marked stop along a route. GPS devices use a waypoint to guide travelers step by step!
quests.funFact: Following a series of waypoints can help guide a traveler safely all the way to their final destination!

quests.instruction: Which agreed spot is where family members reunite after becoming separated during travel?
quests.hint: Think about the exact spot a family agrees to meet at if anyone gets separated in a busy airport.
quests.explanation: A meeting point is an agreed spot for reuniting. Families choose a meeting point in case anyone gets separated!
quests.funFact: Choosing a clear meeting point ahead of time can help a family feel prepared in a busy, crowded place!

quests.instruction: Which office at a station or airport keeps items that travelers accidentally left behind?
quests.hint: Think about the office at a busy station where a forgotten hat or bag is kept safe until its owner returns.
quests.explanation: A lost and found keeps items travelers left behind. Travelers check the lost and found for a missing item!
quests.funFact: Checking a lost and found quickly is often the best way to recover something left behind by accident!

quests.instruction: Which long journey travels all the way across an entire country?
quests.hint: Think about an exciting, long journey traveling all the way from one coast of a country to the other.
quests.explanation: A cross-country trip travels all the way across a country. Families enjoy a cross-country trip to see many new places!
quests.funFact: A cross-country trip can pass through many different landscapes, from mountains to deserts to coastlines!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a person who journeys together with you on a trip?
quests.hint: Think about the friend or family member who journeys right alongside you, sharing every part of your trip.
quests.explanation: A travel companion is a person who journeys with you. A good travel companion makes every trip more fun!
quests.funFact: Sharing a trip with a good travel companion can turn a long journey into a wonderful memory!
